source: Live recording from DeepSeek (deepseek-v4-pro) through its Anthropic-format API, 2026-09-27.

content.text: From what Tokek knows so far, the big one is the Hoi An Lantern Festival, held each full moon of the 8th lunar month, when the old town glows with lanterns on the Thu Bon River — that's per Visit Danang. The International Lantern Festival ran 3–6 December 2026, so it's already passed, and I couldn't confirm anything specific for this exact week.
